title: Compare quotes against a budget and deadline
person: An operations assistant choosing equipment for a small team.
review: All input quantities, prices, shipping and dates are preserved except the explicitly revised quote.

occupation.name: Purchasing Agents, Except Wholesale, Retail, and Farm Products

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
All input quantities, prices, shipping and dates are preserved, except the explicitly revised quote at the revision stage.
Eligibility combines both budget and delivery date; each ineligible option has a correct reason, and the recommendation names the cheapest eligible supplier.
After raising the Northlight quantity by one in a copy, recalculation in LibreOffice raises its total by its unit price.
Currency, dates and column labels are readable and clearly labelled.
Printed, each sheet fits on one page, so the PDF has no more pages than the workbook has sheets.
Studio Supply is ineligible after its delivery change, Northlight is now the recommended cheapest eligible option, and no old recommendation survives in notes, formatting or summaries.
